title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Earth's greatest assassin is killed by his own organization and reborn by a goddess as Lugh Tuatha Dé, heir to a noble family of assassins. His mission is to kill the world's Hero, who is prophesied to destroy the world after defeating the Demon Lord. Lugh trains, kills corrupt nobles and gathers devoted female companions such as his assistant Tarte.
life_message: Skill, preparation and cold judgment used for a larger purpose can justify killing, but a second life should also be lived to the full.

content.note: Protagonist assassinates targets such as a corrupt aristocrat; prisoner interrogation (Wikipedia); AniList Assassins, Guns tags.
Female harem devoted to Lugh (AniList); MangaUpdates lists a Rape category, not confirmed (to verify); MangaDex suggestive.
Harmful drug vizein traded by a corrupt noble (Wikipedia).
Tarte's abandonment and devotion as a 'tool' (Wikipedia).
Assassination and interrogation shown as professional skill (Wikipedia).

dominant: Ends justify means; killing one to save many; noble family duty
